title: These brown butter chocolate chip cookies are everything. Nutty, rich...
description: These brown butter chocolate chip cookies are everything. Nutty, rich brown butter flavor, crisp edges, thick chewy centers, and melty chocolate in every bite. If you love classic chocolate chip cookies but want them elevated… this is the recipe. Ingredients • 1 cup unsalted butter • 1 cup packed brown sugar • 1/2 cup granulated sugar • 1 large egg • 2 egg yolks • 2 tsp vanilla extract • 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour • 1 tsp baking soda • 1 tsp salt • 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips Brown the butter until nutty, let it solidify, then cream it with the sugars for ultra-thick, bakery-style cookies. or Google “Lifestyle of a Foodie brown butter cookies” 🍪 https://lifestyleofafoodie.com/brown-butter-chocolate-chip-cookies/
transcript: You know those $7 bakery cookies you can't walk past? Well, this is that cookie. And I never once let these cool down before eating like three. They're made with a brown butter cookie dough base. And then the bakery secret here is to use either chop chocolate bars or giant cookie chips for those puddles of chalk. Trust me, once you make these, you're never going back.
